Package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.iviewer

Class IViewerApi

java.lang.Object
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.iviewer.IViewerApi
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class IViewerApi extends Object implements AutoCloseable
API to communicate with an OMERO.iviewer.

It is simply used to send ROIs and retrieve metadata from an OMERO server.

An instance of this class must be closed once no longer used.

    • addShapes

      public CompletableFuture<Void> addShapes(long imageId, List<? extends Shape> shapesToAdd)
      Attempt to add shapes to the provided image on the server.

      An attempt is made to send the provided shapes in batches, so that the size of each request body does not exceed PreferencesManager.getMaxBodySizeBytes(URI). However, if a single shape has a size bigger than PreferencesManager.getMaxBodySizeBytes(URI), then the size of the body of the corresponding request will be bigger than PreferencesManager.getMaxBodySizeBytes(URI).

      Note that exception handling is left to the caller (the returned CompletableFuture may complete exceptionally if the request failed for example).

      Parameters:
      imageId - the OMERO image id
      shapesToAdd - the list of shapes to add
      Returns:
      a void CompletableFuture (that completes exceptionally if the operation failed)
